item.title: Lubbock's Valentine's Day weekend is packed with big shows, romantic dinners and cozy events
item.description: Lubbock is hosting a variety of events for Valentine's Day weekend, including concerts, festivals, paint and sip classes, and more.

item.title: LISD Consolidation: District approves locations for new elementary school buildings
item.description: The Lubbock ISD School Board approved locations for three new elementary schools Thursday morning.

item.title: Lubbock Christian School names Sam Collins as new Head Football Coach
item.description: Lubbock Christian School (LCS) announced on Thursday that Sam Collins will become the new LCS Eagles Head Football Coach, replacing Coach Chris Softley. Collins becomes the 17th head coach in Eagles program history, right as the Eagles prepare to celebrate their 60th season of football in the fall of 2026.

item.title: Workforce Solutions highlighting careers for the community
item.description: Workforce Solutions hosted a job fair on February 12th, featuring about 50 booths with a variety of jobs for people of all ages, and encouraged those in similar positions to visit their offices in town.

item.title: Lubbock man convicted of child sexual assault charges
item.description: The above video shows the top local headlines for the morning of February 12, 2026. LUBBOCK, Texas--Alexander Zuniga, 33, was found guilty Thursday, of Aggravated Sexual Assault of a Child. According to court records the charges stem from an incident reported in July 2022 involving a child younger than 14 years of age.

item.title: Black students recount their time going to Texas Tech
item.description: Black students at Texas Tech have found a supportive community on campus, while those working in Lubbock have experienced different treatment, and believe it is important for people to immerse themselves in their culture.

item.title: Two arrested for evidence tampering after fatal motorcycle crash
item.description: The Lubbock Police Department's Major Crash Investigation Unit announced that two individuals, Payton Martin, 19, and Thomas Threet, 24, were arrested on Wednesday in connection to the fatal motorcycle crash on Sunday, February 1, that left Sean Canales dead and Maizie Casares with serious injuries.
